verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships automation features such as spend rules, AI approval routing, and recurring billing, so asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence never mentions versioning, change history, or rollback for automations or rule configurations. The closest item lets users 'review, adjust, or override' individual AI-driven actions, which is an adjacent control over AI outputs, not version management of the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
